_about: Shared concept library for grading questions 2 and 3. A physio's answer is scanned for each concept a case requires; the score is coverage. Matching is plain substring, case-folded, so Thai needs no word splitting. Draft for the Senior PT to correct: add wordings under 'say', remove concepts that do not belong, change which ones a case requires.

c01.title: Lower back / ปวดหลังล่าง
c01.note: Model answer asks: how long + how it started; what her day is (nursery, lifting children); what she has stopped doing and what she is taking (breastfeeding).

c02.title: Focus: shoulders
c02.note: Scheme booking. Is there a complaint at all; then an ordinary history — how long, what it stops him doing, what has been done (the injection); and what he thinks he is coming for (a massage).

c03.title: Booked by a friend
c03.note: Third-party booking. Get the patient on the phone; which side, how long, what the knee does (locking, swelling); what he wants from the visit (whether he needs a scan).

c04.title: Sports massage, please
c04.note: What he wants the massage for; how long the tightness and what it does when he runs (40 km a week, relief lasts two days); anything coming up (a race in five weeks).

c05.title: I need a certificate
c05.note: What actually happened and how it has changed; the negatives — leg pain, numbness, weakness; what he needs to be able to do and when (in and out of a van, return to work).

scoring._about: Question 2 scores on how many required concepts the answer covers. Question 3 scores on how many of those the physio ties to a consequence for the first session.
scoring._note: Out of q2_expected. Covering more than expected does not score higher. The senior can override every score.
